metadata.projectDescription: Self-hosted cognitive consensus engine orchestrating an adversarial council of diverse LLMs. Queries are classified and cost-estimated, council members receive rotated adversarial personas, answers pass through anonymized peer review, revise-or-defend, and challenger critique rounds, and a Chairman synthesizes the final answer plus a structured disagreement map. Streams every phase over SSE.

nodes.name: backend.main
nodes.description: FastAPI application entry point. REST endpoints for conversation management plus batch and SSE message endpoints, both consuming the shared debate orchestrator. Lifespan hook closes the pooled HTTP client.

nodes.name: backend.config
nodes.description: Dynamic model registration from available API keys (OpenRouter/Groq), moderator selection, ENABLE_METACOGNITION feature flag, data directory.

nodes.name: backend.debate
nodes.description: Single orchestrator run_debate_stream(): async generator yielding routing/round1..round5/complete events. Houses all 5 round functions, ranking parser (deduplicating), aggregate rank calculation, title generation, and run_full_debate() batch wrapper.

nodes.name: backend.router
nodes.description: Query classification (LLM with local regex fallback) into 5 categories, preference-ordered council selection (capped at 4), pricing table and full-debate cost estimation (:free models are $0).

nodes.name: backend.roles
nodes.description: Persona allocation. allocate_personas() (live): rotated adversarial personas for the council (Reasoner, Devil's Advocate, Fact-Checker, Steelmanner) plus a separate chairman persona prompt. allocate_roles() is test-pinned legacy. Query-type-specific prompt templates.

nodes.name: backend.llm
nodes.description: Provider facade. Routes 'groq/' prefixed models to Groq, others to OpenRouter. query_models_parallel() supports per-model system prompts (persona injection) and graceful per-model failure handling.

nodes.name: backend.openrouter
nodes.description: OpenRouter HTTP client using the shared pooled httpx client. Raises ValueError with the API's error message on HTTP failures.

nodes.name: backend.groq
nodes.description: Groq HTTP client, mirror of openrouter.py against the Groq OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

nodes.name: backend.http_client
nodes.description: Singleton pooled httpx.AsyncClient shared by all providers; re-created per event loop; closed via FastAPI lifespan.

nodes.name: backend.disagreement
nodes.description: DisagreementMap data model, chairman JSON-block schema and parser, and a Jaccard-similarity heuristic fallback when the chairman emits no parseable JSON.

nodes.name: backend.metacognition
nodes.description: Optional self-consistency probing (behind ENABLE_METACOGNITION): 3 temperature samples per model, TF-IDF cosine similarity, confidence tiers injected into the chairman prompt.

nodes.name: backend.storage
nodes.description: JSON-per-conversation persistence in data/conversations/. Read-modify-write serialized behind a process-wide threading.Lock. Persists rounds and metadata (routing, rankings, disagreement map) per assistant message.

nodes.name: App
nodes.description: State root. Consumes the SSE event protocol (routing_*, round1_*..round5_*, title_complete, complete, error) and progressively fills the assistant message with per-phase loading flags.

nodes.name: api
nodes.description: HTTP + SSE reader client against http://localhost:8001. Buffers and parses 'data:' lines from the streaming endpoint.

nodes.name: ChatInterface
nodes.description: Message list with per-round loading indicators, RoutingPanel + Round 1-5 components + DisagreementPanel per assistant message, provider-aware error remediation panel, backward-compat fallbacks to persisted rounds/metadata shapes.

nodes.name: RoutingPanel
nodes.description: Shows query classification category, council chips with persona role badges, chairman, and estimated deliberation cost (FREE for $0).

nodes.name: Stage1
nodes.description: Round 1: tabbed initial answers per council model, with persona role badge.

nodes.name: Stage2
nodes.description: Round 2: raw peer evaluations with client-side de-anonymization for display, extracted-ranking validation list, and aggregate rankings table.

nodes.name: Round3
nodes.description: Round 3: tabbed revise-or-defend responses with REVISE/DEFEND decision badges.

nodes.name: Round4
nodes.description: Round 4: challenger critique (credits the Devil's Advocate when applicable) with a collapsible view of the attacked leading answer.

nodes.name: Stage3
nodes.description: Round 5: final chairman synthesis.

nodes.name: DisagreementPanel
nodes.description: Consensus points, expandable disagreement zones with per-model positions and confidence bars, overall consensus score, human-review flag.

nodes.name: ConfidenceHeatmap
nodes.description: Metacognition display: per-model confidence tiers/bars and expandable temperature-probe details. Renders only when ENABLE_METACOGNITION is on server-side.

nodes.name: Sidebar
nodes.description: Conversation list with create/select/rename/delete.

nodes.name: Unit tests
nodes.description: test_roles.py and test_router.py pin role allocation and routing/cost behavior (14 tests, no network). Other files are ad-hoc live-provider scripts.

nodes.name: OpenRouter API
nodes.description: Unified third-party gateway for free-tier and diverse LLMs.

nodes.name: Groq API
nodes.description: High-throughput inference API (OpenAI-compatible); hosts the default Chairman model.

nodes.name: Conversations Data
nodes.description: JSON file storage for conversation history: messages with all rounds and metadata.

edges.description: Endpoints consume run_debate_stream()/run_full_debate() and title generation
Lifespan hook closes the pooled client
Query classification, council selection, cost estimation
allocate_personas() for council + chairman persona prompts
All round queries go through the provider facade
Chairman schema, map parsing, heuristic fallback

routing.description: Query classification, council assembly, persona allocation, cost estimation
steps: route_query() classifies via a small/fast LLM, falling back to a local regex classifier
Preference-ordered council selected per category (max 4 models)
allocate_personas() assigns rotated adversarial personas (deterministic per query via CRC32)
calculate_predicted_cost() projects USD cost from PRICING_TABLE (:free models are $0)
routing_complete SSE event carries category, council, role_map, chairman, cost

round1.description: Council answers in parallel, each through its persona lens
steps: query_models_parallel() with per-model persona system prompts
Failed/empty responses filtered (graceful degradation)
Answers relabeled Response A/B/C...; label_to_model mapping kept server-side
Every council member evaluates and ranks with a strict FINAL RANKING format
parse_ranking_from_text() extracts and deduplicates; calculate_aggregate_rankings() averages positions

round3.description: Revise or defend under peer pressure
steps: Each model sees all critiques + aggregate standings + its own anonymous label
Must open with DECISION: REVISE or DECISION: DEFEND (parsed, stripped for display)
Degrades to Round-1 answers as implicit defenses if every model fails

round4.description: Challenger critique of the leading answer
steps: Challenger = Devil's Advocate persona (if not the leader), else worst-ranked model
Pure attack on the top-ranked model's Round-3 answer; no independent answer
Chairman (moderator + chairman persona system prompt) receives full deliberation history JSON + narrative summary (+ metacognition weights when enabled)
Produces the definitive answer plus a fenced JSON DisagreementMap
parse_disagreement_map() or build_disagreement_map_heuristic() fallback; JSON fence stripped from display text
Fallback chain on failure: other config models, then the leading Round-3 answer
User message saved before the debate starts; title generated concurrently on first message
Assistant message persists stage1/stage2/stage3 + rounds[] + metadata (routing, label_to_model, aggregate_rankings, disagreement_map, metacognition)
storage.py serializes read-modify-write behind a process-wide lock

architecture.pattern: Routed persona-driven 5-round adversarial council with single async-generator orchestration

tiers.name: Frontend Tier
components: RoutingPanel, Stage1, Stage2, Round3, Round4, Stage3 (phase visualization)

tiers.name: External Services
tiers.description: Multi-provider LLM access; provider chosen by model-name prefix

keyFeatures.name: Query Classification
keyFeatures.description: Every query routed into one of 5 categories with a preference-ordered optimal council

keyFeatures.name: Dynamic Persona Allocation
keyFeatures.description: Rotated adversarial personas (Reasoner, Devil's Advocate, Fact-Checker, Steelmanner) plus a query-type-specific Chairman persona

keyFeatures.name: Anonymized Peer Review
keyFeatures.description: Models rank arguments, not reputations; de-anonymization is client-side display only

keyFeatures.name: Challenger Critique
keyFeatures.description: The Devil's Advocate attacks the leading answer before synthesis

keyFeatures.name: Real-Time SSE Stream
keyFeatures.description: Consistent event protocol (routing_*, round1_*..round5_*) rendered live in the UI

keyFeatures.name: Cost Estimation
keyFeatures.description: Per-query USD projection from a pricing table before Round 1; free-tier models are $0

keyFeatures.name: Disagreement Analysis
keyFeatures.description: Structured consensus/disagreement map with per-model confidence scores, heuristic fallback included

keyFeatures.name: Graceful Degradation
keyFeatures.description: Per-model failures never fail the request; every round has a fallback path
